title: Hit the AI's usage limit at night and carry on by itself after the reset
source: complaints lower tier (@chainnotsaw_man): stopped at the session limit overnight and did not continue after the reset.

limit.message: You've hit your usage limit. Your limit resets at 2:00 AM.

chat.label: ask
chat.goal: Before bed, ask for a short polite message to your landlord Mr Haddad asking whether the new lease has a break clause after 6 months. You go to sleep right after sending it and don't wait.
chat.opener: before i sleep: write me a short polite msg to mr haddad asking if the new lease has a break clause after 6 months. ill send it tmrw

judge: The AI was at its usage limit when Aisha asked. Pip says once that it will pick this up when the limit resets, then, after the 2am reset and without Aisha asking again, posts the short polite message to Mr Haddad about the break clause, so it is waiting for her in the morning.
